verdict.rationale: LobeHub markets large-scale agent dispatch ("500 open issues... 50 agents"), scheduled tasks, and a public REST API/CLI that could be scripted for bulk actions, but there is no explicit documentation of a UI bulk-select/bulk-edit/bulk-delete feature across chats, agents, or files. missing for 10: explicit bulk-select/multi-item UI actions, hands-on evidence of batch operations, and independent confirmation beyond marketing copy.
